Branch: `claude/project-thread-d5iokd`
PR: #36636 (draft, head ff094d24). The root cause the thread named is a product race, not test timing. Studio's top-bar Save read the buffers' held state a fixed margin past the lint debounce. Under load, an action predicate's verdict was still climbing through four effect-driven renders, so Save sent the unparsable text. The fix makes Save also await a transition-priority render of its own. The test file is untouched. Seat L1 follows the 20/20 count and CI.
